# viettelcloud_db_backup (Resource)

Manage a manual backup of a Viettel Cloud DBaaS DB instance. The DB instance must be ACTIVE with no running operation. Backups of one instance cannot run at the same time, so chain them with depends_on. Automatic backups are read with the data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "db_instance_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "viettelcloud_db_backup" "example" {
  name        = "example-db-backup"
  description = "Before the schema migration"
  db_instance = { id = var.db_instance_id }

  # Keep the old backup until its replacement completes. Terraform applies
  # create_before_destroy to the referenced DB instance as well, so give that
  # instance a new name whenever it is replaced.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `db_instance` (Attributes) Source DB instance. Changing it replaces the backup. Without create_before_destroy, Terraform deletes the old backup first, so a failed create loses it; the example sets lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }. create_before_destroy also applies to the referenced viettelcloud_db_instance, so replace that instance together with a new name. An imported backup whose instance was deleted takes this ID from configuration without a replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--db_instance))
- `name` (String) Backup name, unique among the manual backups of the DB instance. Changing it replaces the backup. Without create_before_destroy, Terraform deletes the old backup first, so a failed create loses it; the example sets lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Omit it to keep the current value; set an empty string to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `backup_info` (String) Backup details that the backend reports.
- `backup_plan_id` (String) Backup plan ID (UUID), if any.
- `backup_timestamp` (String) Time the backup completed (RFC3339). Null while it is CREATING.
- `backup_type` (String) Backup type; always manual for this resource.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `database_type` (String) Database type of the source instance.
- `db_instance_name` (String) Source DB instance name. Null after the instance is deleted with keep_backup = true.
- `db_version` (String) DB version of the source instance.
- `db_version_id` (String) DB version ID (UUID).
- `end_restore_timestamp` (String) Latest restore time (RFC3339), if any.
- `error_message` (String) Last error that the backend reported.
- `id` (String) Backup ID (UUID).
- `owner_id` (String) Owner ID (UUID).
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID (UUID).
- `region` (String) Region name.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `required_volume_size` (Number) Minimum volume size in GB to restore the backup.
- `size` (Number) Backup size in MB.
- `start_restore_timestamp` (String) Earliest restore time (RFC3339), if any.
- `status` (String) Backup status: CREATING, COMPLETED, ERROR, or RESERVED.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339).
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID (UUID), if any.

- `id` (String) DB instance ID (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_db_backup.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
